meta.source_note: Steam 公开搜索页提供发售日期而非小时级发布时间；本报告按发售日期从新到旧选取最新条目。

items.title: 3D剧本杀 焦黑的你
items.short_description: 《焦黑的你》是一款可供四人挑战的3D剧本杀。 故事以一座远离尘嚣的贵族别邸为舞台，一起离奇的烧杀事件在此发生。 玩家将追体验嫌疑人的记忆，在宅邸中展开探索，收集证物，并通过全员讨论来锁定真凶。

items.title: Meow Paw Cursor : 喵爪光标 Demo
items.short_description: 一只软萌的大喵爪追随着你的指尖，踏上每一次点击的旅程。 告别沉闷的默认箭头，让桌面成为一只活生生的猫咪游乐场——每一帧移动都带着肉垫的温度，每一次点击都像喵喵在操作。 小而轻，却让整个桌面都活了起来。喵爪光标 试用版

items.title: 蘑菇农场
items.short_description: 在你自己舒适的农场种植神奇蘑菇！培育30种独特菌类，收集孢子，并在森林漫步中发现稀有真菌。支持31种语言的放置休闲游戏。

items.title: 麦田幸存者 Demo
items.short_description: 《麦田幸存者》是自动开火的动作 Rogue-like。武器锁定最近敌人,你只需走位闪避、抉择每次升级的武器与被动组合。麦田、雪原、熔岩、沙漠、虚空 —— 五张主题地图节奏各异,还能在商店里画一张自己的地图当战斗地面。单局 5-20 分钟,武器进化、进化体建造与永久属性加成让战死不白死。

items.title: Robo Rig
items.short_description: Robo Rig is a 3D, top down, Extraction Bullet Hell where you play as a fully customizable robot. You build your robot, enter battle and destroy enemies, gain coins and collect parts, then you must extract and build an even more powerful robot with the newly acquired parts!

items.title: 魔法少女ファイナルピンクスター
items.short_description: 跳跃动作射击游戏。不擅长飞行的魔法少女。在躲避敌人触手的同时飞行并击败敌人。全6关卡+无尽模式

items.title: 我主沉浮-Master of Fate's Tides Demo
items.short_description: 这是一部AVG故事视觉游戏小说，增加了ARPG的2.5D游戏玩法。你将成为北凉王朝的第三位皇子。你可以通过不同的选择来控制剧情情节方向，解锁NPC偏好，并解锁新的故事情节。

items.title: Throughput Demo
items.short_description: A hyper-abstract city sim where every entity pathfinds to the beat and the soundtrack pulses with your city. Zone, build, watch it breathe.

items.title: Thugz VS Zombies Demo
items.short_description: Build your block defense, recruit wild THUGZ, earn cash, upgrade your crew, and survive the first boss fight in this cartoony tactical zombie defense demo.

items.title: Trump Ballroom Blitz
items.short_description: 拆除特朗普宴会厅。最快时间登上全球排行榜！ 找到挖掘机，尝试尽快摧毁特朗普宴会厅。 使用 WASD 移动，使用鼠标移动相机。

items.title: 故地春寻 Demo
items.short_description: “桥本可以连接一切，过去与未来，繁荣与衰败...可...断掉的桥呢？” 这是一款由新人制作团队weave为大家带来的galgame。在本游戏中，玩家将作为男主角“辛诚”，与本作女主角——桥神“古桥”相遇。玩家可以在游戏中通过选择不同选项触发不同剧情，沉浸式体验与古桥在一起的日常，并通过点击屏幕浏览文本，欣赏配音，鉴赏插画cg，与古桥在平凡的每日中加深了解，相互理解，并一起开启一段令人激动的寻找之旅，寻找那些遗忘的，隐藏的事物。 希望大家可以在我们的游戏中获得欢乐，同时也欢迎大家向我们提出不足。 欢迎大家来体验。

items.title: Project Refactor Demo
items.short_description: 选择注定和失去相伴——那失去之后，还剩下什么？规划每周时间，在事件抉择中经历一段关于选择与和解的人生。

items.title: 古都千年 Demo
items.short_description: 一款以丝绸之路为背景的小镇模拟经营游戏。玩家化身小镇主人，规划生产，应对寒冬酷暑与异域疫病的动态挑战。居民有完整的人生轨迹，生老病死皆在你的见证中。派遣探险队贸易，邂逅历史名人，感受跨越千年的丝路兴衰。Demo包含前期核心经营与贸易玩法。

items.title: Observe. Demo
items.short_description: Your character is named Mason. After a tragic event, you wake up in the middle of the night unable to leave your room. Your computer screen lights up with 3 levels, only 1 is unlocked currently. Complete the first level to unlock the next.

items.title: Confessional Simulator Demo
items.short_description: You're the new priest at St. Augustine's. Sinners kneel on the other side of the screen and tell you everything. Forgive them and your Faith grows. Work the guilt and the donations roll in. Push it too far and the Bishop starts listening. A voiced dark comedy about other people's sins.

items.title: Project Doll: My Only Wish
items.short_description: Project Doll is a Single player, Soft horror, Exploration game set in a rural Japanese school beset by a supernatural curse that has you finding clues, solving puzzles and uncovering the cause of the curse.

items.title: Borrow or Rob Demo
items.short_description: 一款建立在时间倒转之上、洋溢 90 年代复古模拟质感的科幻 roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏。与倒转时间发起攻击的敌人交战——随后由你倒转时间，在逆转的战场上作战。在初次交锋中收集线索，再用自己的策略展开反击。

items.title: Spire of Legends
items.short_description: Ascend a mysterious spire in this deckbuilding roguelike. Master unique characters with passive abilities, active skills, and powerful ultimates while building decks, collecting relics, and battling through ever-changing encounters.

items.title: 得儿猫（Stinky cat）
items.short_description: 一只脸长得“很别致”的奶牛猫，被那个造型愚蠢的飞船绑架到了赛博空间，头上还被吸了个电子马桶搋子！在这款结合了推箱子与炸弹人机制的休闲解谜游戏中，你需要规划路线推动箱子，引爆炸弹粉碎障碍，甚至吞下鲱鱼罐头。躲避疯狗与UFO的追击，在一场场荒诞的爆炸中杀回现实世界！

items.title: Memoirs Demo
items.short_description: In a treacherous place where overflowing emotions are your weapons, descend into the darkness of a broken mind. Fight through twisted memories and survive your deepest fears in this psychological Top-Down arena shooter.

items.title: 致命勇士
items.short_description: 《致命勇士》是一款刷宝动作RPG。踏入魔幻的异世界，挑战无尽怪物、危险秘境与强大首领，收集海量装备与稀有战利品，打造专属于你的终极流派。

items.title: Demon Protocol
items.short_description: Lock On. Light Up. Lay Waste. Demon Protocol is a retro arcade space shooter with 25 waves of relentless enemies, 4 brutal bosses, and power-ups to keep you fighting. Choose your difficulty and see how far you can push before the demons win.

items.title: Quattro Synchro
items.short_description: Quattro Synchro is a Roguelike deck builder with puzzle elements based on the classic four-in-a-row game we all played as a kid. Earn upgrades and multipliers to maximize your score. Unlock 17 chip racks each with their own altered physics and special abilities. Can you make it through the year?

items.title: Cursed Cargo
items.short_description: Cursed Cargo 是一款在线合作喜剧恐怖游戏，环境与怪物一样危险。最多可与 4 名玩家组队，使用基于物理的工具运输不可预测的货物。使用近距离语音聊天进行协作，但要小心——那些存在始终在倾听。

items.title: Flamel's Requiem
items.short_description: Family, power, and survival collide in this atmospheric horror adventure. Craft, fight, and uncover the truth before your illness—and your pursuer—claims you.

items.title: Poolar Bear
items.short_description: 《Poolar Bear》是一款极简滑行解谜游戏，包含 100 个关卡。引导好奇的北极熊穿越平静的泳池，利用漩涡传送门、反弹植物、气流风扇，并避开鲨鱼和食人鱼等危险。简单的方向键操作搭配舒适的设计，带来轻松又烧脑的冒险。

items.title: 矿工生存者 试玩版
items.short_description: 采矿、建造、生存、防御。一款快节奏的幸存者塔防游戏。采掘黄金，建造防御塔与无人机，对抗成群的敌人并击败强大的首领。

items.title: VORTEX-G: Anti-Gravity Racing & Track Editor Demo
items.short_description: Experience the speed of VORTEX-G for free. This demo features Arcade Mode with 3 tracks and 2 fully customizable ships.

items.title: 几何防线
items.short_description: 《几何防线》是一款受经典广告小游戏启发的几何射击游戏。每通过一个关卡，你都将面对不同的强化选择，通过随机词条组合提升能力。不断突破防线，尝试各种成长路线，体验简单、爽快且充满变化的战斗。

items.title: Froggy's Adventures Demo
items.short_description: Play the free opening chapter of Froggy's Adventures! Create your own frog and explore cozy Lilypad City — recover the stolen Golden Fly, brave the pitch-dark Mossy Caverns for the sunken crown, and drive back the Oozing to become a hero. About 20 minutes. Wishlist the full 5-chapter adventure!

items.title: Night Shift Demo
items.short_description: 游乐园中的街机射击游戏：击败一波又一波的敌人，清除公园中的不速之客。解锁各种武器--升级后它们将拥有特殊能力。这是你的第一班岗--你能保护好公园里的景点吗？

items.title: Topidia: The Last Badge
items.short_description: Become the greatest explorer, find the last badges you are missing, and most importantly, be the first to discover Topidia!

items.title: Beerserker: The Stolen Brew
items.short_description: Beerserker is a modern fast-paced arcade game and comical twist. Blinded by the legendary dwarven ale’s taste, Ragna aims to retrieve this masterpiece from the grasp of the gods. Will you be able to make your way through a crowded dwarven brewery? Or end up crushed by their ranks?

items.title: NAOS-01: The Quiet Sector
items.short_description: Trapped behind enemy lines as the Naos scientific-military base descends into chaos, Helios evades capture without reinforcements. Surrounded by hostile patrols, they must move silently through the shadows, infiltrate occupied zones, and send a distress signal before Naos falls completely.

items.title: Nohmen: Blood Rites
items.short_description: Return to your ancestral castle as Kento, a warrior bound by duty, and confront the force corrupting your clan. Battle possessed enemies in fast-paced combat focused on timing, dodges, and counters. Solve puzzles, explore cinematic spaces, and uncover the truth behind the curse threatening all.

items.title: Drunk Dad vs Family
items.short_description: Drunk Dad vs Family 是一款混乱的 4v1 聚会游戏，家庭成员必须在醉酒的爸爸将房子变成一片混乱之前，把他哄睡！

items.title: 50 Years Classic
items.short_description: 50 Years Classic is a minimalist turn-based strategy game where you can choose from a variety of nations, each with its own unique feature. The game offers fast, engaging gameplay with high replayability. This is a free version of the game "50 years".

items.title: 宝石我来捡，你只管揍人: Blood & Blessing
items.short_description: 这是一款快节奏的2D生存动作Roguelike游戏！你流血奋战，她却边治疗边抱怨。消耗你的生命值去砸碎无尽的敌群，与贪婪的AI牧师在极端的资源置换中求生，并靠兼职‘赏金猎人’来赚钱购买你的技能！

items.title: Your Price, Your Honor.
items.short_description: “Your Price, Your Honor.” is a game where you control the choices of a judge who is getting close to retirement. You must manage the public’s tolerance for injustice… and your own wallet.

items.title: Puzzles: Fish
items.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

items.title: Enigmo
items.short_description: Award-winning physics puzzle game now in spatial format! Get your brain in gear!

items.title: Puzzles: Space Cats
items.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

items.title: DISJOINED Demo
items.short_description: Welcome to the world of DISJOINED. The story of the universe has been completed, and all that exists now is the Infinite Mall at the End of Time. With hope, it's up to you to move forward.

items.title: Problem Space Demo
items.short_description: Venture forth through this puzzle game across space. Use your command terminal to guide the Onlooker interstellar probe through treacherous galaxies to explore the farthest reaches of the universe. Avoid asteroids, perform research tasks, and weave through the stars!

items.title: SMTHNG WRNG
items.short_description: Men are mysteriously vanishing in a small, provincial town. A newly arrived guy finds himself trapped in the center of eerie events when someone he believed was gone forever suddenly reappears. What kind of ruthless system is behind this, and who can be trusted?

items.title: Nerds Revenge
items.short_description: 书呆子——多年被殴打、羞辱和嘲笑。现在他们回来复仇了。但肌肉男不会轻易放弃这座城市。选择你的阵营，加入这场全面争夺控制权的战争！

items.title: SiegeBlock
items.short_description: Clear lines, summon troops and defend your kingdom in a medieval falling-block puzzle-defense roguelite. Play solo, team up locally with a friend, or battle in 1v1 versus with rival boards, armies and debuffs.

items.title: 漂流工厂 Demo
items.short_description: 收集资源、研究科技、扩建平台、搭建传送带网络，在危机四伏的海上世界中生存并发展。利用自动化生产线解放双手，让工厂持续运转，最终造出星舰前往火星.

items.title: Chief of the Valley
items.short_description: Build a PC company from a one-person operation in the dawn of computing to an industry titan in the modern era. Manage staff, secure contracts, research technology, and ship products all while keeping yourself from financial ruin. The Valley is an unforgiving place.

items.title: 1 day poison in world
items.short_description: A first-person 3D survival adventure where you explore poisoned levels, activate pressure plates, avoid hazards and enemies, and reach the exit before time runs out.

items.title: Trying to Wake Up
items.short_description: Trying To Wake Up is a 3D platformer focused on storytelling and atmosphere. Journey through a dreamlike world, overcome simple obstacles, and gradually uncover the mysteries behind an emotional and immersive adventure.

items.title: Blek and the Endless Keep Demo
items.short_description: Guide Blek through the twisting grey halls of the Endless Keep as they work to get their memories back! Fight back the Keep's monstrous spawn, meet it's unique denizens, and make thorough use of the art of cat necromancy to find your way back home! The Keep can't truly be Endless, can it?

items.title: ChompBurg Demo
items.short_description: Control an acolyte of Dracula through the mazeburg, collecting villagers and avoiding the hunters to break the score, customize power ups to trigger your combos and become the hunter, transform Chompburg into a point making machine and discover dopamine blasting synergies!

items.title: Sisyphus's Worst Day (again)
items.short_description: Build traps, manipulate the environment, and engineer the perfect loop to keep Sisyphus from ever reaching the summit in this comedic isometric 3D puzzle game.

items.title: Time Dilation Lab
items.short_description: An easy to use, fully adjustable space lab with Einstein's special relativity equations in a three-spacecraft configuration. Play around with time dilation and relativistic Doppler effects in space at your own pace. Multiple viewpoints in 3D, real-time, with data export functionality.

items.title: Gridhammer
items.short_description: Gridhammer is a tactical plate battler where two players draft from one shared pool of 45 plates. Place plates on a grid, capture by matching higher corner values, and chain cascading flips. Every plate you draft is one your opponent loses.

items.title: Above the Sun
items.short_description: Yugemaru, a self-proclaimed gal mechanic, sets out to reach the top of the Acid Tower using the power of steam. With the eerie acid closing in, climb the randomly generated platforms — climb, climb, CLIMB! ...Wait — did I just fall? LOL.

items.title: Just Pool
items.short_description: Just Pool is a minimalist 8-ball pool game. Score all your balls to win the match, play with friends or solo.

items.title: AHA Asset Horde Arena
items.short_description: Survive against endless hordes of enemies, collect powerful ability cards, create crazy combinations of builds and survive for 25 minutes under the onslaught of thousands of monsters alone or with friends.

items.title: Lost Galaxy: Survivors Demo
items.short_description: Defend massive interdimensional portals against relentless alien swarms in this fast-paced sci-fi top-down survival shooter.

items.title: Pixel Exorcist Demo
items.short_description: Play as a young Exorcist tasked with saving a cursed town in this 90's pixel art inspired Investigation-puzzler, with the top down visuals of the RPG's of that era.

items.title: The Wandering Wyrm
items.short_description: Wandering Wyrm is a high-fantasy visual novel with a focus on cooking. Run a tavern on the back of a dragon and serve a variety of unique adventurers. Influence the story with the food you serve!

items.title: Legends of Starkadia
items.short_description: Legends of Starkadia is a quirky turn-based RPG full of quick-time events and action-packed adventure! The Starkadian Empire is under attack by one of their own and it’s up to a team of unlikely heroes to assist the resistance to restore peace by defeating Niko and his legion of interstellar armies.

items.title: Piano Trauma - Stress Deluxe
items.short_description: 款关于驾驶钢琴去演奏音乐会的合作游戏。

items.title: Dreaming With Sharks
items.short_description: Play as a Shark name Doc who is granted wonderful surgical abilities after given strange pills from a mysterious man. Doc excels at his surgeries, but suffers wild hallucinations. Progress each day with a variety of minigames and modifiers in order to become a surgery master!

items.title: Aéro: speedrun labyrinthe
items.short_description: A third-person speedrun puzzle game set in a mysterious sci-fi laboratory. Complete experimental rooms, master your route, improve your best time, follow Aves’ voiced guidance, and search for the 12 hidden bonus eggs.

items.title: Memo R.I.P.
items.short_description: 这是一款第一人称卡牌游戏，恐怖并非持续出现：它只会在对局决定时降临。支持1–4名玩家实时语音聊天，包含900多个动态事件、诅咒式进程，以及等待挑战的最终Boss。

items.title: ホロウソロウ
items.short_description: Hollow Sorrow is a dark yet heartwarming 2D exploration adventure game where you confront your lost past.

items.title: Explosive Escape
items.short_description: Explosive Escape is a fast-paced drifting challenge where every move can be your last.

items.title: Double Driver
items.short_description: Double Driver is a fast-paced arcade driving game that puts your coordination to the test.

items.title: 抓娃娃机任务 DEMO
items.short_description: 一款再现日本抓娃娃机的模拟游戏。足不出户，也能体验到游戏厅特有的那种绝望感。运用各种技巧赢取奖品。解锁奖品和关卡，成为抓娃娃机高手吧。

items.title: Chicken Battlefield
items.short_description: 《鸡群战场》是一款混乱的Roguelite游戏，你将指挥一群装备精良的鸡，与敌对派系展开全面战争。武装你的鸡群，保卫你的基地，在敌人无情的进攻中生存下来，并通过独特的升级、武器和战场特性来调整你的战略。

items.title: Sharp Stock Demo
items.short_description: Sharp Stock 是面向游戏开发者和美术师的本地资产管理工具。支持预览 3D 模型、Spine 动画、音频、图片和字体，提供纹理图集打包、精灵图切分、标签搜索和本地磁盘工作流。

items.title: The Hollow House
items.short_description: A co-op first-person horror game. Search a mysterious wooden house suspended above the clouds, complete objectives, and escape before the creatures hunting you close in. Play solo or with friends across multiple difficulty levels.

items.title: Legacy of the Ark: The Long Awakening
items.short_description: Legacy of the Ark: The Long Awakening is a sci-fi idle progression game where you rebuild a shattered colony ship, restore lost systems, automate production, and uncover the mystery hidden within the Ark’s damaged memory.

items.title: Type Hype
items.short_description: Type to the beat. Letters fall from the top of the screen — type the right keys to the synthwave beat. 54 training levels teach every key, 15 themed exhibition levels push you to mastery, 4 free-roam modes never end. Expert typists welcome.

items.title: Iron Ledger Demo
items.short_description: A high-pressure management sim where you build a defense contractor from nothing, secure contracts, expand production, manage staff and supply chains, and fight to stay ahead of cash flow, compliance, and collapse.

items.title: Kings Call 2 Demo
items.short_description: 在这款《Kings Call 2》中，你将化身为银鹭岭领主！收集卡牌召唤强大生物、释放绚丽法术、击败凶猛怪物，穿越区域守护自己的王国。游戏支持自由构建专属卡组，展开深度策略对战，还能结交盟友团队协作，同时提供快速对局与自由交易的乐趣。四大职业各展神通：法师擅长范围伤害与控制敌军，牧师以治疗和圣光守护盟友，游侠精准打击并掌控节奏，战士则提升团队输出。卡牌品质从白到金，士兵分普通与精英，准备值归零即可部署。来吧，挑战智力与勇气的极限，守护你的王国！

items.title: 大剑25k：邪恶入侵 Demo
items.short_description: 本游戏是一个动作冒险游戏。你的目标是消灭所有能看到的异形生物，可以使用盾牌和剑技，有两类不同的招式，有不同的效果，可以弹反，杀死敌人可以回复一些状态，持续的杀戮才能使你活下去。

items.title: operation
items.short_description: Operation is a zombie horror action game where players enter a sealed operation zone, fight infected enemies, complete mission objectives, and survive with teammates in a dark and dangerous environment.

items.title: Fugaz
items.short_description: Play a flute to solve puzzles and unlock secrets, looking for an exit of a dark place before the darkness consumes everything. In this dark immersive horror puzzle game, knowledge is key to put the pieces together. No music experience required.

items.title: Last Breath
items.short_description: Last Breath is a solo/cooperative terraforming survival game. Dig through terrain, build powerful machines, and restore life to a dead planet. Work together to survive, automate, and reshape the world from the ground up, literally.

items.title: DOI: Defense Shooter
items.short_description: Defend the base and gather energy!

items.title: Little Battle Simulator
items.short_description: Create the battlefield of your dreams and fight! Monsters, vast armies, rivers and forests, multiple teams… Anything goes! Create your own battle in "Sandbox". Witness the chaos in "Random Battle", Achieve the highest possible score in "Challenge"

items.title: OUTWORKS
items.short_description: 建造高耸的立体要塞，守住防线。层层叠楼、立起城墙，并按高度部署炮塔，抵御从四面逼近核心、不断升级的地面与飞行机械大军——然后看着一座坍塌的高塔将一切一同拖垮。一款精炼、霓虹、纯代码打造的基地防御 Roguelite。

items.title: Vapor Storage Manager Demo
items.short_description: 一款智能、安全的清理游戏垃圾的实用工具。Vapor Storage Manager 可帮您寻找并清除已删除游戏中被遗忘的数 GB 着色器缓存、Steam 创意工坊模组以及残留文件。在 PC 或 Steam Deck 上释放数十 GB 空间——对您的游戏存档绝对安全！

items.title: Waterpump Simulator Demo
items.short_description: Start with a simple water pump and turn a small roadside stand into a thriving business. Sell drinks, upgrade your equipment, unlock new products, improve your workflow, and serve an ever-growing number of customers as you build your own successful roadside business from the ground up.

items.title: Tamespire
items.short_description: A cozy-dark creature-collection roguelite deckbuilder. Tame Spirelings, fuse their moves into a living deck, and climb a Spire that rebuilds itself every run. Evolve your team, master five clashing elements, and push your luck through endless Ascensions.

items.title: ZeroOut
items.short_description: Complete puzzles by zeroing out the board! This is achieved by placing the pieces onto the board. Once the piece is placed, the numbers of the affiliated squares on the board will decrease based on the number of the piece. Pieces may need to be rotated or flipped.

items.title: Throne of Trials
items.short_description: A hardcore turn-based boss rush RPG where preparation is key. Assemble a 4-member party from 15 classes, and customize them with dropped gear and skills to defeat rule-breaking bosses. Read enemy intents, manage hate, and execute tactical interrupts in this deep strategic experience.

items.title: Arsica: Echoes of Ars
items.short_description: Arsica is a 2D Platformer RPG where you play as a demon hunter carrying a power no army ever had. Four demons claimed the lands. Mankind retreated to its last shelter. You are not here to survive. You are here to end it. Build your team, forge your gear, hunt every monster and four demon.

items.title: Down The Stairs: The Game
items.short_description: Down The Stairs: The Game is a physics-based ragdoll challenge where every clean stair run, brutal fall, shaft setup, and ghost race pushes you toward a better score. Stay in control, hit the beams, beat other players’ ghosts, and master the descent.

items.title: Burger Maker
items.short_description: A puzzle game where you combine randomly falling ingredients on 10 turntables to fill customer orders. Preparing stock in advance is just as important as filling orders. New menu items are added as your rating climbs, making things increasingly hectic. Use combos and chains to reach 5 stars!

items.title: Very Disco, Disco Very! Demo
items.short_description: 规划你的行动，锁定计划，然后看着混乱展开。 《Very Disco, Disco Very!》是一款支持1–8人的战术派对游戏，所有玩家同时编程自己的行动。每回合选择一个6步序列并锁定，但完美的策略往往无法幸存。

items.title: Khaldun: Text Based Strategy
items.short_description: Khaldun is a medieval-themed ASCII graphics kingdom management game. Take part in realistic war simulations and decide every detail of your kingdom, from its economy to its demographics! Your decisions will shape the life of a nation. Rise or be lost to history...

items.title: Polyomino
items.short_description: Polyomino is a falling block roguelike where you build powerful synergies through boons, powerups, and upgrades. Face tricky bosses, use unique powerups, drop special Polyominoes and craft unique builds in a unique, endlessly replayable climb to the top.

items.title: Heavy Wake
items.short_description: Explore a cursed island in a short dark-fantasy deckbuilding RPG. Recruit strange survivors, build a party of unlikely allies, and survive tactical card battles as Fyodor searches for a cure for his dying tribe.

items.title: PROJECT: OJISAN
items.short_description: 这是一款把中年大叔叠起来的游戏。在你想放空大脑的时候玩一玩吧。

items.title: DEMON SIEGE
items.short_description: A retro-inspired Micro-FPS Bullet Heaven, where every powerup stacks infinitely. Become an unstoppable demon-slaying powerhouse with insane speed, massive jumps, multi-bullet weapons, and game-breaking builds.

items.title: Monster Breeder
items.short_description: Breed unique monsters where every baby inherits its looks AND stats from both parents. Hatch eggs, grow your collection, and send your creatures on turn-based adventures for gold and glory. With endless procedural designs, no two monsters are ever the same. How powerful can your bloodline become

items.title: Silicon Scars
items.short_description: Running. Gunning. Reading.

items.title: Moonlight Peaks
items.review_summary: 特别好评 此游戏的 167 篇用户评测中有 89% 为好评。
items.short_description: 在《Moonlight Peaks》中体验吸血鬼的生活！掌握药水制作和咒语施放的艺术，悉心照料你的超自然农场，并与本地狼人、女巫和美人鱼成为好友——甚至坠入爱河。永恒唾手可得！

items.title: Tiny Frontier
items.short_description: Hide as anything. Paint it to match. The whistle will give you away anyway. A multiplayer prop hunt where Hiders disguise as world objects and hand-paint their camouflage, while Hunters sweep the level with scanners, washers, and capture tools to drag them out. Up to 16 players.

items.title: Truck Maxxing
items.short_description: Plow, Shoot, or throw saw blades at swarms of enemies in this truck based Roguelite action game! Tons of upgrade options per run with each run being unique and challenging. Earn scrap after each run to purchase cosmetics and customize your truck!

items.title: 海鸥灯塔Seagull Lighthouse Demo
items.short_description: 在一座灯塔里读信、回信、等信。没有倒计时，没有排名，没有任务。只有一片海，一群会送信的海鸥，和一些不知道什么时候漂来的瓶子。瓶子里装着陌生人的人生。你的回信可能会影响他们的故事。在这个焦虑快节奏的年代里，让自己慢下来。

items.title: Chrono Survivors - Arena Survival Roguelite
items.short_description: Survive waves of enemies as a time-bending chronomancer! An action roguelite with auto-attack, XP collection, upgrade choices, and class-based ultimate abilities

items.title: The Beekeeper
items.short_description: A fast systemic strategy puzzle about ecological scarcity and timing. Place limited hives on a hex grid, protect fragile species, and optimize under pressure knowing some losses may be inevitable.

items.title: Bahast
items.short_description: A dark fantasy idle ARPG where you prepare a character, send them into automated PvE runs, collect loot, craft stronger gear, and shape your build through skills, passives, and long-term progression.

items.title: 十三张: 死斗&肉鸽
items.short_description: Thirteen: Risk & Rogue 是一款融合 roguelike 生存与十三张扑克策略的卡牌对战游戏。你将带着有限的筹码，闯过多关挑战，每一关都是一场真正的脑力博弈——活下来，就是胜利。

items.title: BLIGHTEN Demo
items.short_description: BLIGHTEN is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

items.title: ZodiacLottery Demo
items.short_description: 一个彩票 Roguelike 游戏. 移动动物, 打造属于你的中奖彩票, 并结合强力遗物与丰富的协同效果, 赢取惊人的巨额奖金!

items.title: Golfcremental Demo
items.short_description: BUILD! GOLF! EARN! BUY! Turn $50 into your own golfing empire by building custom golf courses and then automating them to get hole in ones. Unlock unique golf course pieces and use them in unique ways to make more money.

items.title: Vultures
items.short_description: Vultures is a single-player, real-time factory simulation where you construct and manage an ambitious manufacturing operation in a volatile and chaotic market that will eventually crush you and your dreams.

items.title: 要塞实验室 试玩版
items.short_description: 要塞实验室(Fort Laboratory)是一款2D对冲式塔防/轻度ROGUE游戏，玩家需在游戏中建设基地、武器和工厂来抵御成群上百的敌人。收集各种不同的物品和建筑，构筑独特的防御体系，保护核心直至攻击结束。

items.title: The Essence of Thievery Demo
items.short_description: The Essence of Thievery is an incremental game with a focus on exploration, discovery, and travel. Command your thief underlings to discover, steal, and wield the power of Essences to push back the Silent Fog and save the world.

items.title: House Of Trauma Demo
items.short_description: From Shooteo's YouTube Channel comes House of Trauma, a first person horror game where you play as Gabriel, a CPS worker assigned to a possible case of abuse of a child named David at a mysterious home. You soon find that this house hides much darker secrets than you could've ever imagined.

items.title: Neural Descent Demo
items.short_description: A difficult 2D platformer built around movement mastery

items.title: Left Not Right Demo
items.short_description: 左手操作左边，右手操作右边，可同时进行! 这是不需要朋友的单机游戏，可放心进行。 可用双手同时移动两个角色，试图完成逃离地下研究室。

items.title: galaksia online
items.short_description: Galaksia Online is an action-packed, 2D multiplayer space MMORPG blending retro pixel art aesthetics with mechanics. Forge alliances, custom-build your starships block by block, and engage in massive faction-based PvP wars or challenging PvE raid battles across dangerous stellar sectors.

items.title: Chessman Adventures
items.short_description: Every move matters in this chess-inspired tactical adventure. Lead three heroes and outsmart the undead.

items.title: YEET! The Elite
items.short_description: Play as Earth itself in this chaotic arcade action game where you grab elite figures and YEET them into the Sun while dodging UFOs and surviving frantic planetary swats from the Moon, Venus, and Mercury.

items.title: Day Breaker - Awakening Code
items.short_description: As Mia a resistance scout you investigate a remote island after a blackout. Discover a prototype AI that equips you with a suit, boosting your skills, combat and crafting. Face two advanced AI Agents crucial to Nex AI plan as you upgrade your abilities and fight to stop Nex from wiping out humanity.

items.title: 超魔球！ホームランダービー Demo
items.short_description: Read the unpredictable breaking balls and hit a home run!!! You can create your own original breaking balls and compete against others in an online mode!!!

items.title: Sokobomb Demo
items.short_description: 《推彈小子》是一款益智解謎遊戲，你要靠炸毀障礙物來開路前進。

items.title: Solar Defiance
items.short_description: A fast-paced arcade space shooter where every wave pushes you harder. Collect coins, buy upgrades, and build your ship into an unstoppable force — or die trying.

items.title: Desolation Seed
items.review_summary: 好评 此游戏的 25 篇用户评测中有 84% 为好评。
items.short_description: An atmospheric survival shooter placing you inside a hyper-violent maze of urban waste, environmental biohazards, and societal ruin. Scavenge, explore, and survive while finding a path out of a late stage modern Shinar

items.title: Conquer for Glory Demo
items.short_description: 一款横版策略游戏，召集军队，征服黑暗奇幻世界。统领八大种族之一，用兵种、怪物和独特技能击溃敌军防线，逐个王国地征服整张地图。

items.title: Corefall: Idle Dungeon RPG Demo
items.short_description: Assemble a party of heroes, descend into a living 3D dungeon, and watch them fight. A deep idle RPG with TONS of ENDLESS Content!

items.title: Blob of Ink Demo
items.short_description: Blob of Ink is a short incremental game where you grow a tiny living ink blob into something greater. Consume letters, unlock magic powers, gather ink, and evolve into your final form.

items.title: Iron Circus × INDIEPOCALYPSE Game Jam
items.short_description: Six weird games from six killer team-ups between indie game devs and indie comics artists! We've got puzzles, adventures, exploration, and baby werewolves in this collab between Iron Circus Comics x INDIEPOCALYPSE!

items.title: WHERE IS MY CAT?
items.short_description: Your cat is missing. This is terrible! It was kidnapped and hidden by an unknown, evil Entity that terrorizes the tenants of your house because it is bored. Finding the cat is now your unsolvable problem. You will go crazy before the end. This is not a threat. It's a statistic.

items.title: Simulation 9
items.short_description: 你在一条无尽的走廊中醒来，脑海中毫无记忆。 一个声音向你打招呼，并解释说在你死后，你的意识被置于一个计算机模拟环境中。 不幸的是，系统开始出现故障，你必须报告这些故障以修复模拟环境。

items.title: Stellar Harvest Demo
items.short_description: Play the opening of Stellar Harvest for free. Build your planetary energy empire, experience your first prestige, and begin the journey toward constructing a Dyson Sphere.

items.title: The Dark Forest Calls Demo
items.short_description: Explore an isolated village swallowed by darkness and fog. Search for supplies, manage limited resources, use light carefully, and survive a slow-burn first-person horror experience where every sound can matter.

items.title: Aevalore Demo
items.short_description: No dialogue. No filler. Just chaos. Choose a hero, master their 81 skill combinations, survive the 10-minute horde across deadly maps. With 300,000+ build combinations, how will you survive? Level up, play your cards right, and conquer the bosses. AEVALORE: Your hero, your build, YOUR CHOICE.

items.title: Nicu Ștefan Cristian's Mongol 2 Demo
items.short_description: Call me Mongol! Some time ago, I ventured into Agrippa's perilous realm to claim the false god's life. Armed with an arsenal of weird weapons given onto me by Mithrithnogg, the prophet of worms, I uncovered a dark truth that shook the very foundation of reality!

items.title: Canyon Raid
items.short_description: 《Canyon Raid》是以3D重塑的经典之作。驾驶独特战机穿越程序生成的峡谷，消灭敌人、收集XP、解锁强力升级。这款Roguelike空战射击游戏兼具经典魅力与现代玩法。

items.title: The Last Tale Told: Spam
items.review_summary: 好评 此游戏的 10 篇用户评测中有 90% 为好评。
items.short_description: 你独自一人生活，在家办公。连日来的绵绵细雨让你足不出户，已经好几天没出门了。每天电话铃声响起，显示的都是陌生号码。屏幕上显示着“疑似诈骗”。你以为这只是垃圾电话。

items.title: 星际深钻
items.review_summary: 多半好评 此游戏的 24 篇用户评测中有 70% 为好评。
items.short_description: 探索未知星域，采集稀有资源，迎战外星生命，并不断升级你的飞船——在这片无垠宇宙中开启一场循环往复的生存冒险。这是一款短小精湛的太空采矿与探索游戏，你会面临不同的挑战与惊喜，并收获满满的多巴胺与解压感。

items.title: Landlord Simulator
items.short_description: You’re buying your first apartment and stepping into the world of real estate. Buy properties, rent them out, take care of your tenants, and keep your apartments in good condition. Be careful who you let move in, build your empire, watch the market, and become the most successful property owner.

items.title: Chest & Compass: Isles of Vaultara
items.short_description: Sail from a cozy tavern into cursed, ever-changing islands in this tactical turn-based RPG. Bring back treasure, unlock classes, recruit allies, and let an ancient chest shape every voyage.

items.title: miniquest Demo
items.short_description: A retro fantasy quest shrunk down to mini-size! Challenging turn-based combat meets the tight pacing of an arcade game in this minimalist RPG. Become the Chosen Ones and vanquish the Dark Lord, all in the span of a couple of hours. Then do it again! And again. And again... forever?

items.title: SOR.OP: Dark Shades
items.short_description: SOR.OP: Dark Shades is a realistic first-person shooter from SNRC Studios with beautiful graphics, precise controls, and over 25 maps. Play in 6 modes, including Team Deathmatch, Free For All, Domination, and Zombie Mode. Tactics, skill, and teamwork are the key to victory.

items.title: Data Center Simulator Game
items.short_description: From unfinished ground to multi facility campuses you'll build it all while managing the needs of your demanding customers! Racks, Cluster planning, UPS beeping, Fires, Water intrusion, Insider Threats and more!

items.title: Thrice-a-dice Demo
items.short_description: Trice-a-Dice is a roguelike Dice-Builder. Roll dice to earn money. Raplace dice faces for better ones and combine into the best. Buy Cats to create synergies with faces and upgrades. Deal with the Devil, gamble in slot machine and buy Angel's help. All of this just to pay to play further.

items.title: Esports Manager 2026
items.review_summary: 多半好评 此游戏的 549 篇用户评测中有 77% 为好评。
items.short_description: 建立并领导您自己的职业电子竞技组织。招募球员、管理合同、培养人才、聘请员工、打造品牌，并在深度逼真的管理模拟中争夺冠军头衔。

items.title: Gorotsuki Paradise
items.short_description: Gorotsuki Paradise 是一款在线 PvP 卡牌游戏，你将在对战中边战斗边构筑牌组。招募个性各异的 gorotsuki，在犯罪都市埼玉中生存并崛起。游戏重视选择与判断，完全免费游玩，没有 Pay-To-Win 机制。

items.title: GoblinGate Demo
items.short_description: Goblin Gate 是一款紧凑的黑暗奇幻放置游戏：资助你的哥布林战团，通过重铸获得决定本轮风格的 PACT 碎片，并向大门深处推进。每次重置都会让这场突袭更凶狠。

items.title: Space Fleet Logistics
items.short_description: Wars are won by logistics. Command the Federation's fleets across a star system, manage supply chains, secure planets, and outmaneuver a relentless AI enemy. Every battle is decided before it begins.

items.title: SableSyn Protocol Demo
items.short_description: Engage enemies in turn-based battles on an 8 X 5 grid where each team controls their half of the battlefield. Each battle is a test of planning and execution. Success depends on managing your resources and choosing the right tradeoffs at the right moment.

items.title: Kamikaze Survivors
items.short_description: Kamikaze Survivors is a top-down Roguelike where players command, equip, and level up battleships from WW1 to the present day. Participate in the First Blitz on London, Pearl Harbor, and Operation Epic Fury in command of history's most famous warships.

items.title: UpDown&Shot
items.short_description: Load the revolver and guess the dealer's number. Wrong? Then put the barrel to your head and pull the trigger.

items.title: Snake: Gridbreaker Demo
items.short_description: Play the first loop of Snake: Gridbreaker. Defeat the Gatekeeper, unlock Ghost Snake, progress Anomaly Signal, and carry your save into the full game.

items.title: SCP: Short Story
items.short_description: SCP: Short Story is a first-person shooter set in a world where the K-class scenario destroyed almost every living form. You’ll have to get through this dead world, retrieve essential documents from Site-17, and most importantly - do not get killed by what survived.

items.title: System Cleaner Demo
items.short_description: Bullet heaven meets base building. System Cleaner is a survivorslike set inside a broken computer, where you fight corrupted files and place helpful buildings as you go. Clean up waves of glitches your way: dodge and shoot through the chaos, or build a growing setup that does the work for you.

items.title: Idle DeepMiner
items.short_description: 你操控一把有生命的镐，一路凿穿世界直抵地核。 将它向下发射，升级并改造它，见证一次普通的坠落如何演变成充满爆炸、闪电与连击的混乱奇景。

items.title: Alchemic Beasts Demo
items.short_description: 款怪物驯养 RPG，你的魔兽之间的社交化学反应将决定它们如何建立羁绊、战斗与协作。与 Zieg 和 Mioni 一起夺回野性乐园 Mizu，驯服强大的怪物，并让度假村重现昔日辉煌。

items.title: Tiny Towers Demo
items.short_description: 这是一款短小精悍的增量放置游戏，你需要抵御成群小怪物的袭击，保卫你的微型堡垒。建造防御塔，通过击败敌人获取资源，并在技能树中解锁全新升级，从而不断强化你的哥布林要塞。

items.title: 勇之证
items.short_description: 《勇之证》是一款 3D 俯视角 Rogue Lite 动作游戏。一个调查团的临时队员，为了证明自己的勇气，独自进入古堡探索诡异幻境，在随机生成的房间里与各类怪物战斗，每次死亡都将带着新的祝福重新开始，搭配 Build 打造专属玩法。

items.title: Mandala
items.short_description: 一款音乐驱动的波次射击游戏，只有一条规则：停下来射击，移动来闪避。分形世界随音乐实时变化。导入你自己的音乐，打造属于你的体验。

items.title: By My Side
items.short_description: 带着忠犬在身边，于荒野中求生。你一无所有地被冲上岸，驯服一只流浪狗，把它养成你的伙伴——建造家园并为其供能，熬过无情寒冬，直面一个会反击的世界。

items.title: SLANT Demo
items.short_description: A 2D puzzle platformer game where you reach the goal point by overcoming various traps and puzzles.

items.title: Viroblitz
items.short_description: a mysterious virus is inhabiting planets around the cosmos.. Together with your dragon Ringo, you voyage through space, dodging projectiles and eliminating the spreading virus.

items.title: Pogo Panic
items.short_description: Pogo Panic is a punishing parkour climb where you can play solo or co-op. Bounce on a pogo stick, burst a fleeting jetpack, and fight gravity through vertical sky courses with optional checkpoints. Turn them off for a full no mercy run.

items.title: Another Slop Game
items.short_description: Another Slop Game is a chaotic medieval co-op platformer where you and your friends jump, fall, scream, and suffer through floating ruins, giant traps, stupid obstacles, and terrible decisions. Play solo or online with friends. Reaching the top is optional, losing your mind is guaranteed.

items.title: Uptime: A Cloud Provider Sim Demo
items.short_description: Build a cloud provider from a garage to a hyperscaler - rack the hardware, run every cable, route the traffic, keep customers online. A first-person infrastructure sim where ports, power, fault domains, RSTP and BGP do real work, not flavour text. Readable for newcomers, honest for engineers.

items.title: Rush Word
items.short_description: Rush Word is a fast-paced competitive word game where players race to find and type words before their opponent. Play solo to improve your vocabulary or challenge friends in online 1v1 matches through Steam invites.

items.title: Silly Typing Game Demo
items.short_description: A lightning-fast typing roguelike where vocabulary meets high-octane arcade survival. Adapt to shifting HUDs, chaotic bosses, and brutal viruses across procedural runs. But beware: the more efficiently you type, the closer the interface looks back at you.

items.title: Evercrown
items.short_description: A turn-based tactical roguelike where your heroes’ actions are decided by a slot machine. Spin, lock, and reroll abilities, read enemy intentions, build powerful synergies, and push your run into explosive late-game scaling.

items.title: Flat Mars Demo
items.short_description: Flat Mars is an action roguelike FPS. Shoot your way through millions of demons and tear through the terrain with an arsenal of futuristic weapons to claim powerful relics.

items.title: The Obsession
items.short_description: The Obsession — 顶峰在召唤你！ 准备好征服这片矗立在无尽海洋中央、直插云霄的几何世界了吗？《The Obsession》是一款基于技巧的3D平台跳跃游戏，发生在一个远离喧嚣、只有你和跑酷的宁静世界。

items.title: DUSK OF WAR Demo
items.short_description: DUSK OF WAR is an idle clicker incremental war management game. As the WAR MINISTER, you are in charge of the army, the industry, the finances and the logistics. PROTECT YOUR COUNTRY TODAY!

items.title: Marianara Deep
items.short_description: Dive into the exciting aquatic-themed space world of Marianara Deep! A vigorous shoot 'em up bullet hell, filled with area-denying bullet patterns to challenge players! Join one of our crew members to shoot 'em all!

items.title: Clusterbug
items.short_description: Clusterbug is a space-themed, insect-filled, and futuristic bullet hell shoot 'em up. Travel through the insect-filled world as you cleanse it from a bio-mechanical virus that has turned any living being infected by it into frenzied mech mutations, bringing freedom and peace.

items.title: Cellula
items.short_description: Manage a colony of living cells in a strategy game built from real biology. Build phospholipid membranes, place organelles, import nutrients, fight viruses, detect cancer, and divide your cells to grow. No tutorials. No lectures. Learn by keeping the cell alive.

items.title: Viroblitz Demo
items.short_description: a mysterious virus is inhabiting planets around the cosmos.. Together with your dragon Ringo, you voyage through space, dodging projectiles and eliminating the spreading virus.

items.title: Herb's Homegrown Havoc
items.short_description: Herb's Homegrown Havoc is a simple but chaotic arcade roguelike. Pluck plants out of the ground before they rot and summon hostile creatures! Upgrade after each round to increase Herb's strength and skills in various ways.

items.title: Ultimate Sportsball Championship
items.short_description: Ultimate Sportsball Championship (USC) is the mixed sportsball game your mom warned you about. You are not ready for this. Keep scrolling.

items.title: Anhedonia: Sanctuary of Ash Demo
items.short_description: 踏入一个被圣经启示录吞噬的世界。作为一名寻求救赎的堕落牧师，与恶魔般的恐怖作战，净化受折磨的灵魂，收集残存的一切，重建灰烬圣所——在垂死世界中的微弱之光。

items.title: Skyfire Embers
items.short_description: Skyfire embers is an explosive dragon adventure seeking its final resolution. Dodge, weave and fire your way through challenging bullet patterns in this hand-animated shoot ‘em up!

items.title: 黑圣化:悟空
items.short_description: 暗黑魔气席卷三界，齐天大圣受黑圣之力侵染，肉身与神魂逐渐异化，堕入黑圣化异变之中。本作是一款西游题材挂机养成游戏，玩家化身黑化悟空，离线挂机自动刷怪闯关，无需时刻操作也能源源不断收获经验、装备与养成资源。

items.title: Nightclub Empire
items.short_description: Build and manage your own nightclub in this first-person business simulation. Serve drinks, hire staff, expand your venue, and turn a small bar into a luxury nightlife empire.

items.title: Cryotank Rogue Demo
items.short_description: Cryotank Rogue is a fast-paced 2D sideview twin-stick roguelike shooter set in a brutal cyberpunk apocalypse. Fight through procedurally generated levels, loot weapons and augments, and evolve into a deadly machine to survive permadeath runs.

items.title: Junkoid
items.short_description: "Clear the galaxy in Junkoid! Inspired by arcade classics, take control of your ship and blast through space trash before it crashes. Featuring fast-paced action, smooth controls, and the ultimate challenge: beat your high score. Do you have what it takes? Start the cleanup now!"

items.title: JAMBREDREK: PURE DETECTIVE
items.short_description: Investigate a series of brutal murders in a remote forest county. Search for clues, explore disturbing locations, encounter horrifying creatures, and uncover the truth in this first person horror experience.

items.title: Ore Shatterer
items.short_description: 只需移动鼠标即可粉碎矿石！无需点击，将光标悬停在矿石上即可将其摧毁，在轻松愉快的体验中荣登 Steam 全球排行榜。

items.title: Ultimate Wizard Demo
items.short_description: 在这款奇幻类轻肉鸽 (Roguelite) 幸存者游戏中，消灭成千上万的敌人，不断提升实力。寻找 法术并进行强化，搭配构筑流派核心装备，发掘隐藏秘密，提升等级，踏上成为终极法师之路 ！

items.title: Thunder Infinity
items.short_description: Thunder Infinity takes classic shoot 'em up gameplay to the next level by adding survival, roguelite, and bullet hell elements. Choose your pilot, ship, and weapons, and destroy the Varkon Star Empire in the final offensive of the Aegis Star Bastion.

items.title: Forest Fighters
items.short_description: 具有战略深度的街机益智战斗。建造超级积木，触发连锁反应以发送飞行幽灵方块。通过仔细的时机应对传入攻击。23个角色，每个角色的游戏方式独特。没有付费赢的功能。

items.title: Touhou - Kira's Fangame Collection
items.short_description: A collection of 6 in 1 free to play fangames based on the Touhou Project! Play as Reimu and other iconic characters in these couch co-op adventures that include genres such as platforming, metroidvania, tower defense and 3D stealth!

items.title: Obey the Rules: Forest
items.short_description: An endless path lies ahead. Break the rules, and it will never end. Observe, deduce, and make the right choices to find your way out.
developers: うさうさはっぴーげーむず
publishers: うさうさはっぴーげーむず

items.title: BitVoxel
items.short_description: BitVoxel is a 3D voxel sandbox where you build real digital circuits. Connect gates, switches, LEDs and wires to create simple circuits, reusable components, or massive logic systems limited only by your imagination.

items.title: Market Simulation: Rush Hour
items.short_description: 一款快节奏、充满动作元素的第一人称超市模拟游戏。

items.title: XeGrader plus
items.short_description: 探索与解谜是掌握胜利关键的奇幻射击游戏。以缜密的像素艺术描绘而成的幻想世界为舞台，揭露隐藏在各关卡中的未知秘密。一边获得强力的强化道具，一边以精准的操作与敏锐的射击，击破逼近而来的奇幻世界怪物，开拓世界的命运！

items.title: miniBattle
items.short_description: miniBattle is an oldskool-inspired, turn-based tactical battler for up to 4 fighters. Lob grenades over hills, read the wind, stalk foes through fog of war, grab airdrops, and capture the flags — solo against bots or online via Steam.

items.title: Monster Smoosh
items.short_description: Drop monsters into a jar and smoosh the matching ones together to climb an 11-creature ladder — from humble fuzzball to derpy elder god. A physics-chaos merge game where combos run big, cows are currency, and death is a feature, not a fail-state. Easy to start. Gloriously hard to put down.

items.title: 三国演义：汉朝再兴之梦
items.short_description: 开启刘备振兴没落汉室的伟大征程！这是一款以优美背景音乐与可爱像素图形重新诠释的三国志 SRPG。 通过活用 14 种多样化兵种间的克制关系与计策进行战略战斗，在 50 多个战场上大显身手，亲手引领衰败汉王朝的伟大复兴吧！

items.title: 龙沉异世录
items.review_summary: 多半好评 此游戏的 21 篇用户评测中有 71% 为好评。
items.short_description: 这是一款复古8位像素风格的RPG游戏，游戏采用回合制的玩法，在这个奇幻的世界中探索未知。

items.title: I'm Making a Monster
items.review_summary: 好评 此游戏的 19 篇用户评测中有 89% 为好评。
items.short_description: Piece by piece, you pour your soul into the monster. This is your burden and you bear it willingly. Your friends think that this is unhealthy.

items.title: Armed Snake
items.short_description: Armed Snake is a top-down action roguelike where you control a snake on a grid battlefield. Grow your body, survive enemy waves, and evolve powerful upgrades to clear the run. Each run is a fresh challenge. Pick your playstyle, survive the waves, defeat the bosses, and build the deadliest snake.

items.title: VELATO
items.short_description: VELATO is a Poker-Bluff Roguelike Deckbuilder where players build a Joker-driven economy engine, manipulate AI opponents through bluffing, and survive escalating table pressure across each run.

items.title: World: 23806
items.short_description: 进入一个神秘的程序化世界，在第一人称射击与动作类 Rogue 循环中战斗、搜刮与成长。你将面对游荡的敌人，开启散落的宝箱，收集枪械、近战武器与装备，并用每次冒险获得的资源强化角色。继续深入可能得到更好的奖励，也可能失去本局成果；及时返回则能保留收获，为下一次进入做准备。每一次世界生成都会带来不同的地形、节奏、敌人分布和掉落选择。死亡不是终点，而是下一轮挑战的开始。不断调整你的武器和路线，在未知世界中走得更远。

items.title: Forge Maiden Demo
items.short_description: Forge Maiden 将你的专注时间锻造成武器。使用番茄工作法，鉴定随机词条，完成顾客订单，并帮助一位签订契约的少女赚取 10,000 枚金币，重获自由。

items.title: Chrono Tower
items.short_description: Chrono Tower is a soulslike command RPG focused on 1-on-1 mind games. Read your enemy, choose the best response, raise your win rate, and kill at 100%. Build your own playstyle with stats, equipment, skills, and magic as you climb a tower twisted by time.

items.title: At Face Value Demo
items.short_description: Every card is worth exactly what it says, so draw a few thousand of them. At Face Value is a witty, deceptively deep incremental about turning one humble deck of cards into a runaway point-printing machine. Draw, upgrade, shuffle, repeat… just one more time.

items.title: Schizophrenia: The Last Shift
items.short_description: Remembering the past while corruption occurs, you are set out to finish the remainder of your shift until you cannot anymore. Stock the shelves using your forklift and be a productive member of society while evading the inner demons within you in this horror survival to meet quota.

items.title: Nyctophobia
items.short_description: Nyctophobia is a first person horror game where you play as a new motel worker who is afraid of the dark. As soon as you step into a dark area you start hallucinating scary faces, your goal is to survive your shift.

items.title: Cig Walk
items.short_description: A place where civilization burned out long ago, but the snow still falls, and the wind still howls between dead apartment blocks. There are no missions. No miracles. Just the cold, the silence, and the soft glow of a cigarette. Relax in this doomer walking simulator and smoke them if you got them.

items.title: アンダーワールドモンスターズピンボール Demo
items.short_description: Introducing *Underworld Monsters Pinball*, a fresh take on pinball where you aim for high scores with a cast of quirky monster characters riding the ball! Hone your skills and aim for your personal best score!

items.title: Bounce Ball Clicker
items.short_description: Bounce Ball Clicker is a stage-based clicker & puzzle game where you place various items on a 7x7 grid and bounce balls to collect a target number of coins. Build the optimal route while considering item synergies, and earn the target amount with maximum speed and efficiency!

items.title: Idle Village
items.short_description: An interactive idle game with a relaxing medieval setting. Start from nothing and slowly build your village by gathering resources and hiring villagers to populate and help build.

items.title: Charon's Obol Demo
items.short_description: Challenge Death himself in a coin-flipping roguelike across the Greek Underworld. Build a tableau of mythic coins, discover unexpected synergies, and wield the powers of Olympus to bend fate in your favor.

items.title: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus Demo
items.short_description: Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.

items.title: Pictures at an Exhibition
items.short_description: Aozora Haru, a troubled, recently orphaned art student, finds it hard to attach much meaning to many of the things in his life. Through the meaningful bonds he has created with the people close to him, however, he begins to understand that life is much more important than it initially seems.

items.title: FINIS ACTUS
items.review_summary: 褒贬不一 此游戏的 11 篇用户评测中有 63% 为好评。
items.short_description: 1891年，伦敦。在一位著名魔术师的宅邸里，现实与疯狂之间的界限正在崩塌。许多自诩聪慧之人在这条走廊里迷失了方向。在帷幕落下之前，你能否洞悉幻象背后的真相，抑或将成为这场悲剧的牺牲品？

items.title: Chrome Shadow Demo
items.short_description: A 2D pixel-art detective adventure where you investigate a brutal murder in a city drowning in corruption, secrets, and political tension. Search locations, question suspects, collect evidence, and uncover a truth that was never meant to surface.

items.title: 101 Dogs Hidden in New York
items.review_summary: 好评 此游戏的 11 篇用户评测中有 100% 为好评。
items.short_description: 加入这场冒险，在精心打造的纽约景观中，探索101只狗狗的藏身之处🐾。🏆赢取海量成就。你能找到多少只狗狗🐶呢？🔎快行动吧！⏱️

items.title: FishPond
items.short_description: 建造一个每条鱼都拥有独特遗传编码的活水池塘。繁育稀有特征，平衡氧气与饥饿，解锁新物种，并看着你的生态系统实时谱写自己的原声带。部分是模拟器，部分是放置游戏，部分是一场进行得无比精彩的科学实验。

items.title: Nin Ninja RESCUE MISSION
items.short_description: Nin Ninja Rescue Mission is an action, adventure, platform, and endless runner game. Run, face dangerous enemies, dodge traps, defeat enemies, and use your skills to complete a rescue mission.

items.title: Wizard Gold
items.short_description: An incremental game about an ancient stone that turns wood into gold. You collect fallen wood and feed it to the stone for gold, then hire wizards, buy upgrades, and cast spells. Prestige to start once again with permanent power to help you feed the stone even more.

items.title: The King's Game: Through the Veil
items.short_description: The King's Game is a 3D chess game where the pieces are concealed from your opponent. with two game modes; standard two-player chess and a circular board three-player chess variant. All across multiple atmospheric 3D environments.

items.title: Mic Simulator
items.short_description: You are a mic! a Romanian skinless grilled sausage! on the grill! A third-person comedy sim about doing absolutely nothing while you're slowly getting smoked. Maybe you can listen to the radio? It's a nice day outside.

items.title: a monkey
items.short_description: 《AMonkey》是一款以《西游记》为背景的快节奏2D牌组构筑Roguelike。您将化身猕猴，在随机生成的取经路上展开冒险。游戏核心循环清晰明快：战斗 → 三选一获取卡牌/法宝 → 构筑/升级牌组 → 挑战更强Boss。 游戏的核心乐趣在于深度策略构筑。您可自由组合超过60张效果各异的卡牌，形成独特战斗流派，例如追求一击制胜的爆发流、侧重高频攻击的连击流，或依靠格挡反击的防御流。 游戏内容丰富，包含10多种能改变战局的强力法宝，以及10位以上拥有独特机制的首领Boss。每一次失败都意味着下一次能带着更丰富的策略开局，保证了极高的重玩价值。 准备好迎接这场充满策略与随机性的快节奏卡牌冒险了吗？

items.title: Mythfall Demo
items.short_description: Mythfall is a fast-paced bullet hell MMO where skill and strategy determine survival. Battle relentless monsters, loot powerful gear, and grow stronger as you fight to defend your homeland from the mighty wizard Alivarg.

items.title: Master Fall
items.short_description: Master Fall is a 2D psychological horror puzzle-platformer where players rotate the world to manipulate gravity, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets as reality slowly collapses into a surreal nightmare.

items.title: Incarnation - Lifetimes
items.short_description: All is not what it seems, will you have honed your skills enough to emerge victorious, or will you have to restart numerous times? Death is to be expected; each failure refines your choices. There is little RNG, your choices alone will decide your fate!

items.title: Pickel: The Mysterious Mine
items.short_description: 一场神秘的大地震袭来，小镇居民销声匿迹。化身为主角“皮科”，深入探索黑暗的地下世界。随着每一次挥动镐头，奇异的痕迹接连浮现……越往深处走，小镇隐瞒的巨大真相就越清晰。在这座矿山的尽头，究竟有什么在等待着你？

items.title: Twelve Boxes
items.short_description: 你的任务只有一个：把箱子搬到卡车上。 听起来再简单不过了。 但这栋房子并不正常。 各种异常现象潜伏其中，而发现它们，是你逃离这场无尽搬运工作的唯一方法。 12 个箱子。 1 条规则。 千万别出错。

items.title: Yips!
items.short_description: Throw the ball, chase it, and climb higher. Yips! is a pixel-art precision platformer where you must overcome unpredictable innings using a single baseball and carefully aimed throws.

items.title: Irondrive Demo
items.short_description: Your base is moving. Your crew is exhausted. Manage task priorities, automate critical repairs, and keep your colonists alive as your fortress drives through hell.

items.title: City Cardz
items.short_description: Collect 1200+ city cards from 600+ different cities, build your deck and compete in strategic card battles inspired by cities from around the world. Discover unique card abilities, different combinations, and interesting city facts as you outsmart the opponents.

items.title: Dodgeball Blast Demo
items.short_description: 《Dodgeball Blast》是一款轻松有趣、动作感十足的 Boss Rush 游戏！ 闪避、接球、投掷，在史诗级战斗中奋战！挑战拥有独特能力的强大 Boss，向终极躲避球大师的目标迈进！

items.title: An Adventure in Arabic
items.short_description: An Adventure in Arabic is a series of games that teaches Arabic Language. Chapter One, introduces Arabic Alphabet. Learn the various shapes and pronunciation of each letter while enjoying playing an Adventure RPG. The game has something to offer for all ages, feature rich and full of activities.

items.title: Where Is Mommy
items.short_description: Trapped in a bazaar that twists with every turn, you are a lost child searching for your mother. Watch for subtle anomalies in the shifting environment to survive the loop. In this retro-inspired world, nothing is as it seems. Can you find her before the cycle swallows you whole?

items.title: The Pawn Broker
items.short_description: The Pawn Broker is an atmospheric horror economic survival game. Run a cursed pawnshop, analyze every item that comes through for signs of theft or dark curses, and make high-stakes decisions to stay profitable before your five days are up.

items.title: 1.80战神微变
items.review_summary: 好评 此游戏的 30 篇用户评测中有 93% 为好评。
items.short_description: 全新传奇《1.80 战神微变》打破传统战法道界限！全新「神器使者」单职业登场，集近战爆发、远程范围、辅助增益于一身！

items.title: Overlab
items.short_description: Combine atoms to create molecules and fulfill orders to survive as long as possible.

items.title: FOCUS
items.short_description: 监控画面正在被一点点改写。找出变化之处并予以报告的点击式观察恐怖游戏。

items.title: The Incident
items.short_description: The Incident is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a closed circus, destroy evidence before investigators arrive, and avoid someone still inside watching your every move.

items.title: SavingSanta
items.short_description: VR Virtual Reality, Single Player, Runner where you save Santa from those that want to stop him from giving gifts to the world

items.title: Spirit of the Dome
items.short_description: 在这款即时战略风格的塔防游戏中，在日渐衰败的世界中抵御源源不断的敌人浪潮和黑暗势力！

items.title: Escape From Ashville Demo
items.short_description: 搜刮、战斗并撤离——否则失去一切。 一款高风险的撤离射击游戏，专注于生存、战术战斗和关键决策。

items.title: Fantasy World Simulator
items.short_description: Open a Pixie shop and dive into an adventure with whimsical creatures. Tame, train, and evolve Pixie characters, then explore the vibrant city with them. Manage your shop, serve customers, and grow your business. Join now and create your own Pixie legend!

items.title: The Daily Parlay
items.short_description: Challenge your friends in a high-stakes blend of card strategy and brutal arena combat, where a round of President decides your rank! Your hierarchy dictates your power in battle, letting you exploit your friends from the President's throne, or forcing you to beg for mercy as the Scum!

items.title: Infernal Gate
items.short_description: Dive into Infernal Gate and its engaging Story Mode, driven by a rich dialogue system. Annihilate enemies using a highly complex system of ranged, melee, and throwable weapons. Master your loadout with a deep inventory system to adapt and survive every brutal encounter.

items.title: 五行策(WuXing Card)
items.short_description: 五行策是一款融合中国传统五行元素的策略卡牌游戏，你将通过巧妙搭配英雄技能与各类道具，构筑强力连携，冲击极限高分，在变幻莫测的战局中寻找属于自己的制胜之道。

items.title: Son of Beach Demo
items.short_description: Start as a Beach Caretaker Intern. Clean up trash left behind by tourists and recycle it to unlock powerful new tools. Follow the changing tides to dig up hidden treasures beneath the sand. Catch seafood, run your own seafood stand, and sell rare coastal collectibles in your treasure shop.

items.title: JULPAE
items.short_description: JULPAE is a free-to-play 4-player online card battle game with a Korean-inspired atmosphere. Learn the flow quickly in 1v1 duels, then infer hidden teams, play or pass, and read the match through timing, decisions, and mind games.

items.title: Adira Nusantara
items.short_description: Master authentic Silat combat as Adira, a fierce heroine battling flesh-eating monsters to break a curse on her village. Experience a unique fantasy world rich with South-East Nusantara culture, stunning visuals, and an evolving arsenal of powerful weapons. Prepare for an unforgettable journey!

items.title: Rootbound Enigma
items.short_description: Rootbound Enigma is a first-person puzzle adventure where curiosity leads to treasure, and mistakes lead to danger. Solve puzzles, overcome traps and parkour challenges, and explore atmospheric underground ruins.

items.title: Renz Tower Defense
items.short_description: Fast-paced minimalist tower defense featuring upgradeable towers, economy management, and escalating enemy waves.

items.title: Runaway Dog Demo
items.short_description: In Runaway Dog, embark on an arcade adventure. Explore 3 unique maps, battle enemies, and overcome obstacles in a fast-paced, fun, and addictive journey to rescue your little dog.

items.title: BrainRot Defender
items.short_description: Defend your Lifenode from waves of Scrollers, Trolls, and Doomscrollers in this chaotic 2D arena shooter. Upgrade, survive, and beat the algorithm.

items.title: Brick Game
items.short_description: A retro-inspired classic arcade brick-breaker

items.title: Speed King Demo
items.short_description: Race as anything from pigs to firetrucks in a chaotic 3D racer where every competitor has unique abilities and every track brings unexpected challenges.

items.title: The neon undead
items.short_description: Rock and wreck you way through two tap shoot 'em up game, with 30–40 minutes gameplay. With wild settings from a quiet log cabin to the circus and the various settings, fighting in the name of revenge

items.title: Syndeo-Complex
items.review_summary: 褒贬不一 此游戏的 23 篇用户评测中有 65% 为好评。
items.short_description: In Syndeo-Complex you will explore five different environments connected by a hub. Each level has its own mechanics, weapons, enemies and bosses. The Keli, small droids, will (probably) guide you in your quest.

items.title: UpDown&Shot Demo
items.short_description: Load the revolver and guess the dealer's number. Wrong? Then put the barrel to your head and pull the trigger.

items.title: Lizard Slayer Demo
items.short_description: A pixelated adventure doom-like RPG set in Slavic mythology.

items.title: For the Crown
items.short_description: A puzzle logistics builder where lemming-like workers transport resources across a limited island. Create production chains, optimize routes, upgrade your castle and solve increasingly complex space and logistics challenges. The island never gets bigger. Your logistics problems do.

items.title: SharedScreen Wagons 2 Demo
items.short_description: 单屏本地多人混乱。最多8名玩家、8个手柄、3个键盘。快节奏回合、锦标赛和友情压力测试。装载、卸载、抢道、拆毁——物流撑不住。

items.title: 退款 Demo
